posts.title: Red foxes hunting in deep snow
posts.body: Winter forces the red fox to change tactics. Listening through a snow pack, it locates prey by sound alone before diving head first into the drift. This post looks at how the red fox survives a hard winter.

posts.title: The red fox of the temperate forest
posts.body: Vulpes vulpes is at home in mixed woodland, moving through undergrowth between the trees. We follow a forest fox through a full season.

posts.title: A close-up look at red fox facial markings
posts.body: The white and black markings on a fox face are individually distinctive. A portrait study of the red fox at close range.

posts.title: Gray wolves crossing a snowfield
posts.body: A wolf pack covers enormous distances in winter. Canis lupus travels single file across open snow to save energy.

posts.title: Gray wolves in old-growth forest
posts.body: Forest wolves behave differently from tundra populations, using tree cover to approach prey.

posts.title: Teaching your dog to swim
posts.body: Not every domestic dog takes to water. A patient introduction to a shallow lake works better than a push off a dock.

posts.title: Brown bears fishing in the river
posts.body: Every summer the grizzly returns to the same stretch of river to catch salmon in the shallows.

posts.title: Deer grazing in an open meadow
posts.body: A red deer stag spends the early morning feeding in open grassland before returning to cover.

posts.title: Hiking misty mountain ridges
posts.body: Above the fog line the ridge becomes an island. A guide to walking alpine ridges when the valley is full of cloud.

posts.title: A quiet morning on the empty beach at sunrise
posts.body: Arriving before anyone else, the sand is unmarked and the sea is flat. On the value of an early start.

posts.title: How to make Neapolitan pizza at home
posts.body: A wood oven is not required. With a hot stone and a wet dough you can get a credible margherita out of a domestic oven.

posts.title: The perfect espresso at home
posts.body: Grind size, dose and a clean basket matter more than the machine. Pulling a balanced shot into a warm cup.

posts.title: Gothic cathedrals of northern Europe
posts.body: The pointed arch let builders push stone higher than anyone expected. A short tour of the great gothic facades.

posts.title: Suspension bridges over water
posts.body: A suspension bridge turns a river crossing into a span problem. How the cables carry the deck.

posts.title: Restoring vintage motorcycles
posts.body: Stripping a 1970s two-stroke down to the frame, and what to do about the carburettor before anything else.

posts.title: Coral reef conservation underwater
posts.body: Bleaching events are now annual on some reefs. What reef restoration teams actually do below the surface.

posts.title: Telling a fox from a wolf in the field
posts.body: Two canids, very different animals. Size, tail carriage and gait are the field marks that separate a red fox from a gray wolf.

posts.title: Winter forest walks
posts.body: Snow changes the acoustics of a woodland completely. Where to walk when the forest is under snow.
